verdict.rationale: Brex's marketing and API docs explicitly describe budgets, auto-enforced spend limits, per-transaction limits, and card issuance controlled via the Team API and Budgets API, directly matching the finance-lead's need for per-card limits and granular employee controls. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the granularity (e.g., per-category or per-merchant controls) and no detailed UI walkthrough beyond marketing copy.
